title: Bounded-below etale coordinates for the finite-site tower
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring with elements in universe $u+1$, and let $X,Y$ be schemes in universe $u$. Use their small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Define $D^e_R(X)=D^+(X_{et},R)$, the full bounded-below derived category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. For a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$, define $P^e_f:D^e_R(X)\to D^e_R(Y)$ as the total right derived direct image $Rf_*$ of the sectionwise etale direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For an open immersion $j:X\hookrightarrow Y$ [def-weil-open-immersion], define $J^e_j:D^e_R(X)\to D^e_R(Y)$ as the exact extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] applied termwise and descended to the bounded-below derived categories. These are the existing finite-site coordinate abbreviations, with their inherited objects and morphisms. No finiteness, Noetherian, nonempty-scheme or nonzero-ring hypothesis is imposed.
